action.decision_reason: GMC-screened count is 12 and GMC-guided screened count is 8, both above the minima (10 and 4), and the required generate->screen->regenerate->rescreen cycle is complete, so the MC discovery gate is passed; d7d960548ee7 is the strongest GMC design across all far-field and tail metrics, making it the priority for the first of two available certifications.

action.expected_observation: A new batch of legal fixed-inventory GMC-guided candidates derived from the top GMC flux fields, ready for GMC screening to extend the verified ranking toward a second MC certification.
action.decision_reason: The discovery cycle requires continued GMC-guided regeneration from screened parents; the top four GMC designs give the strongest leakage-path guidance, and MC budget is exhausted, so further unbiased certification is impossible and design progress must come from GMC-guided generation and screening.
